name: claude-skills
description: Personal library of reusable Claude Code skills, distributed as plugins so they can be installed into any project without committing them.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Workflow-driven code review: auto-detects the diff source (PR / local branch / working tree), reads the full surrounding context of each changed file, and reviews in ordered passes — intent, correctness, architecture, tests, readability, then minor nits last. Includes React / TypeScript / a11y / perf checks.
